answer: Proof-of-space-time per ID: each identity must commit a unique 64 GB plot seeded by its key, and every hour a random beacon value picks 32 challenge offsets the ID must answer within 30 seconds. Answers form a hash thread, each linking the previous proof, so skipping an hour breaks the chain. Running 100 sybils means 6.4 TB of real disk, and plots spiral up 10% per month of tenure, so cheap mass clones stay priced out.
